text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- New taxation system replaces VAT today. Government says the new system of customs and excise duties on products and services is tailor made for Malta. The Federation of Industry warns it could have a negative impact on industry.

- Dockyard pays compensation to victims of Malta Drydocks explosion. Nine workers died in accidental explosion on Libyan tanker Um El Faroud two years ago. Relatives had been in dispute with the dockyard on compensation but this was finally agreed after the prime minister intervened on the relatives' behalf.
- Stall owners complain of confusion on implementation of new tax system.
